Cordial/Friendly: How do you feel about our friendship? (Cordial to Companion)
"Why, are you getting tired of me? If you are, just be straight with it. I've got thick scales."
Close: "Friendship is a strong word. But not inaccurate."
Allied: "I'm not good with feelings. You know that. I like you. I like what we get up to together."
Companion: "Come on, do I have to say it? You could run straight into Oblivion or worse, and I'd be right there with you."

Cordial/Friendly: "I think you're good at what you do, and with me, you're even better."
Close: "I'm not used to watching someone else's back. Or having them watch mine. I don't hate it."
Allied: "You seem the type to have a lot of friends in a lot of places. Don't know why I'm one of them, but I'm glad I am."
Companion: "Didn't ever think I'd spend so much time traveling with another person. I'm glad it's you."

Cordial/Friendly: "We make a good team. Anyone can see that."
Close: "Steel sharpens steel. We make each other better."
Allied: "I'll just say that I don't often cross paths with people I'm glad to meet. You might be the first."
Companion: "Trust always seemed like something I'd never find with another person. But like most good things in my life, I found it with you."

Cordial/Friendly: "I'm not always the most productive when I tag along with you, but it seems like time well spent."
Close: "Look, if I'm quiet, don't take it the wrong way. I went a long time without having someone around to share my thoughts with."

Cordial/Friendly: Let's talk about something else. (Returns to Greetings)
